actions.script: invoice=ec.entity.find('mantle.account.invoice.Invoice').condition('invoiceId',invoiceId).disableAuthz().forUpdate(editable).one() def org=ec.service.sync().name('zenith.purchase.OperationsServices.get#PurchaseOrganization').call().organizationPartyId allowed=invoice!=null && invoice.invoiceTypeEnumId=='InvoiceDebitNote' && (ec.user.isInGroup('ADMIN') || (org && invoice.toPartyId==org)) if(editable && invoice?.statusId!='InvoiceInProcess') allowed=false if(!allowed && errorOnDenied!='N') ec.message.addError('Debit note not found, outside your organization, or closed for editing.')

return.message: Select your authorized active organization before creating a debit note.

actions.script: def taxable=BigDecimal.ZERO,cgst=BigDecimal.ZERO,sgst=BigDecimal.ZERO,igst=BigDecimal.ZERO,cess=BigDecimal.ZERO ec.entity.find('mantle.account.invoice.InvoiceItem').condition('invoiceId',invoiceId).list().each {line -> taxable+=(line.taxableAmount!=null ? line.taxableAmount : (line.quantity ?: 0)*(line.amount ?: 0)) as BigDecimal cgst+=(line.cgstAmount ?: 0) as BigDecimal;sgst+=(line.sgstAmount ?: 0) as BigDecimal;igst+=(line.igstAmount ?: 0) as BigDecimal;cess+=(line.cessAmount ?: 0) as BigDecimal } def tax=cgst+sgst+igst+cess,grand=taxable+tax // Keep unrounded, tax-inclusive grand and unpaid totals; the stored round-off remains separate. ec.service.sync().name('update#mantle.account.invoice.Invoice').parameters([invoiceId:invoiceId,invoiceTotal:grand,unpaidTotal:grand-(access.invoice.appliedPaymentsTotal ?: 0),totalTaxableAmount:taxable,totalTaxAmount:tax,totalCgst:cgst,totalSgst:sgst,totalIgst:igst,totalCess:cess]).call()
